name: Walking Route Generator
description: Generate walking routes based on vibes like greenery, safety, and quietness. Uses OpenStreetMap data to find the best paths.
author: IBM Hackathon Team

generateWalkingRoute.title: Generate Walking Route
generateWalkingRoute.description: Create a walking route optimized for user preferences (vibes). Supports point-to-point routes and circular loops.

mode.title: Route Mode
mode.description: Type of route: 'point_to_point' for A to B, 'circular_loop' for round trips
x-]ibm-nl-intent-examples: I want to walk from A to B
Plan a route to the park
I need a round trip walk

origin.title: Starting Point
origin.description: Where the walk starts (latitude and longitude)

destination.title: End Point
destination.description: Where the walk ends (for point-to-point routes)

duration_minutes.title: Walk Duration
duration_minutes.description: How long the walk should take in minutes

vibes.title: Vibe Preferences
vibes.description: What kind of walking experience the user wants

responseMapping.successMessage: I've generated your walking route! It's {{metadata.distance_meters}} meters long and will take about {{metadata.estimated_duration_minutes}} minutes. {{metadata.transparency_narrative}}

geojson.title: Route GeoJSON
geojson.description: The route geometry for map display

origin_lat.prompt: Where would you like to start your walk? Please share a location or address.

duration_minutes.prompt: How long would you like to walk for? (e.g., 30 minutes, 1 hour)

mode.prompt: Would you like a round-trip loop or a one-way route?

clarificationPrompts.missingLocation: I'd be happy to plan a walking route! Could you tell me where you'd like to start?
clarificationPrompts.missingDuration: How long would you like your walk to be?
clarificationPrompts.ambiguousVibes: I want to find the perfect route for you. What's most important: being surrounded by nature, staying on safe well-lit streets, or finding a quiet peaceful path?
